description: Shinra Electric Power Company presents Motor Mobiles.
A silver open race car rotates beside a list of specifications.
A bronze three-wheeled buggy has an open seat and exposed pipes.
A bulky black sedan turns, with rounded fenders and gold trim.
Cutaway views reveal the engine and chassis beneath the body.
A green cylinder is labeled Makou Engine.
A diagram shows the suspension assembly.
The advertisement names the new S five-ten, then lists Japanese dealerships.
